rules.law_name: Notice to quit for nonpayment of rent
rules.citation: General Law - Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 31
rules.title: Notice to quit for nonpayment of rent
rules.requirement: A landlord giving a residential tenant a written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent must include the required state form with repayment-agreement documentation and information about rental assistance, court rules, and eviction restrictions. In a nonpayment eviction, the court may not accept the writ, summons, or complaint without proof that the landlord delivered the form.
rules.key_value: form required with notice to quit; information in 5 most common languages in addition to English

coverage.summary: Applies to written notices to quit for nonpayment of rent given by landlords to residential tenants, and to nonpayment summary process filings for residential dwelling units.

rules.penalty: No court with jurisdiction over a chapter 239 summary process action, including the Boston municipal court department, may accept a writ, summons, or complaint for filing in a residential nonpayment eviction without proof of delivery of the required form.
rules.interaction: Applies to summary process actions under chapter 239, including in the Boston municipal court department; the form must include information on relevant federal or state legal restrictions on residential evictions.
rules.quoted_span: A notice to quit for nonpayment of rent given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant pursuant to this chapter shall be accompanied by a form that shall include, but not be limited to: (i) documentation of any agreements between the tenant and landlord for the tenant to repay the landlord for nonpayment of rent;
